errors.text: Adding only 1–2 at.% Ta or W to FeCoNi does not satisfy the stated almost-equiatomic multicomponent-composition requirement, even if its ideal configurational entropy might exceed 1.0R.

The cited studies concern mechanical strengthening, irradiation-induced precipitation, or deformation behavior and provide no evidence that Ta/W addition or the proposed precipitates increase magnetic coercivity.
The intervention and mediator do not reconstruct the target dual-phase equiatomic FeCoNiTi alloy containing fcc and C14 Laves phases.

The proposed mechanism conflates dislocation pinning and magnetic-domain-wall pinning without demonstrating magnetic anisotropy, magnetic character of the precipitates, or interphase magnetic coupling.
